narrative.overview: A tool for people who maintain heritage guides every day. Calm, light, institutional-but-friendly: a cool grey canvas, white surfaces, one purple that means action, current item and focus, and status told by an icon and a word before any colour. Density is comfortable, rows are 52 px, controls are 40 px (44 on touch). The visitor result and the content lead; the chrome recedes.
keyCharacteristics: Light only, cool neutrals, one purple accent (UNICHE) used for action, current item, links and focus.
Hairlines for structure, a stronger control border (3:1) for every control edge.
Four-pixel spacing with half steps; one line-height per type size; Montserrat with a Manrope Greek companion.
Three cool shadow steps; flat at rest, lifted only for surfaces that float.
One focus ring (2 px --ring, 2 px offset) everywhere; a state ladder of rest, hover, pressed.
Every state is a word and an icon; forced colours keep a boundary on every control and surface.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Purple is the action, the current item, links and the focus ring. A page has one primary button per region; nothing else is purple-filled.

rules.name: The Hairline Is Not an Edge Rule
rules.body: --border is decoration and may be 1.4:1. Every control edge uses --input (4.26:1 on white).

rules.name: The One Height Rule
rules.body: Each type size has exactly one line-height, set by the size token. No leading-* utility in chrome.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards carry shadow-1 and a hairline; only popovers, menus, toasts and a stuck toolbar use shadow-2; only dialogs use shadow-3.

rules.name: The Gap Shows the Surface Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is 2 px with a 2 px offset so it reads against the canvas and a filled button alike. No halo, no white ring.

dos: Do use the ui/ primitives (Button, Chip, FormField, Input, Alert, AppDialog) and the tokens; never a local copy.
Do state status as an icon plus a word (DRAFT, ACTIVE, ARCHIVED; never 'published').
Do give a blocked control a reason (disabled-reason) and keep it focusable.
Do put one sentence per failure, chosen by code, with one request-id row.
Do use a 44 px hit area for text links in dense rows (hit-44).
donts: Don't use text-[Npx], rounded-[, shadow-[, z-[, tracking-[, uppercase or a hex colour in CMS chrome.
Don't use a coloured side stripe, a gradient CTA, glassmorphism or an eyebrow label.
Don't use .field-input, .field-label, .dialog-* or the Button aliases in new screens.
Don't remove a focus ring; replace the ring only on a control that draws its own focus state.
Don't show the server's detail text; never print an unstyled error message.
